# Model specification: uart 1.0.0

Asynchronous serial port (USART/UART) as used by PX4 and ArduPilot for console, GPS, telemetry and RC (8/9-bit, parity, stop bits, DMA).

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | Character transmit/receive with status, errors (stored) and interrupts. |
| dma | DMA requests for transmit and receive. |
| fifo | Transmit and receive FIFOs. |
| inversion | Signal inversion and pin swap. |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| enable | control | base | The port is active; while off, nothing is sent or received. |
| tx_enable | control | base | The transmitter may send. |
| rx_enable | control | base | The receiver accepts characters from the line. |
| word_length | control | base | Data bits per character (7, 8 or 9, including the parity bit when enabled). |
| parity | control | base | None, even or odd. |
| stop_bits | control | base | 1 or 2 (0.5/1.5 stored only). |
| baud_divider | control | base | With the kernel clock (and oversampling) it gives the bit time. |
| oversampling | control | base | 16 or 8; enters the bit time. |
| tx_data | data | base | Writing a character queues it for transmission. |
| rx_data | data | base | Reading returns the oldest received character. |
| tx_space | status | base | Another character can be queued. |
| tx_complete | status | base | All queued characters have left the line. |
| rx_available | status | base | At least one received character can be read. |
| idle_line | status | base | The line has been idle for one character time after reception. |
| overrun | status | base | A character arrived while the receive storage was full; it is lost. |
| framing_error | status | base | Stored only; the model's line never produces framing errors. |
| parity_error | status | base | Stored only; the model's line never produces parity errors. |
| status_ack | ack | base | Driver action that clears idle_line, overrun, framing_error, parity_error, tx_complete. |
| tx_irq_enable | control | base | tx_space raises irq. |
| tc_irq_enable | control | base | tx_complete raises irq. |
| rx_irq_enable | control | base | rx_available or overrun raises irq. |
| idle_irq_enable | control | base | idle_line raises irq. |
| irq | event | base | The port's interrupt line (Devicetree interrupts). |
| tx_dma_enable | control | dma | tx_space raises the transmit DMA request. |
| rx_dma_enable | control | dma | rx_available raises the receive DMA request. |
| tx_dma_request | event | dma | Transmit DMA request (dmas entry tx). |
| rx_dma_request | event | dma | Receive DMA request (dmas entry rx). |
| fifo_enable | control | fifo | Transmit and receive FIFOs are used. |
| rx_fifo_full | status | fifo | The receive FIFO is full. |
| tx_fifo_empty | status | fifo | The transmit FIFO is empty. |
| rx_invert | control | inversion | Received levels are inverted (SBUS). |
| tx_invert | control | inversion | Transmitted levels are inverted. |
| swap_pins | control | inversion | TX and RX pins exchanged; stored, no effect in the model. |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-UART-B001 | base | While enable or tx_enable is off, writing tx_data sends nothing; while enable or rx_enable is off, characters from the line are dropped without status. |
| ADV-UART-B002 | base | A queued character occupies (1 start + word_length + stop_bits) bit times on the line; characters leave in the order written, each starting when the previous one ends (ADV-UART-003/004). |
| ADV-UART-B003 | base | tx_space is on whenever another character can be queued; tx_complete turns on when the last queued character has left the line and stays on until status_ack or a new tx_data. |
| ADV-UART-B004 | base | A received character becomes readable at rx_data at its completion clock and rx_available turns on; reading the last readable character turns rx_available off. |
| ADV-UART-B005 | base | When a character completes while the receive storage is full, it is lost and overrun turns on until status_ack. |
| ADV-UART-B006 | base | One character time after the last received character with no new character, idle_line turns on until status_ack; it does not turn on again before another character is received. |
| ADV-UART-B007 | base | irq is raised while (tx_irq_enable and tx_space) or (tc_irq_enable and tx_complete) or (rx_irq_enable and (rx_available or overrun)) or (idle_irq_enable and idle_line). |
| ADV-UART-B008 | dma | rx_dma_request is raised while rx_dma_enable and rx_available; tx_dma_request while tx_dma_enable and tx_space. |
| ADV-UART-B009 | fifo | With fifo_enable, up to the IP's FIFO depth characters can be queued or held for reading; rx_fifo_full and tx_fifo_empty report the FIFO ends. |
| ADV-UART-B010 | inversion | Inversion settings are stored and reported; the model line carries logical characters, so they do not change data. |
| ADV-UART-B011 | base | Transmit and receive are independent (ADV-UART-005). |

**Timing.** Character completion clocks follow ADV-UART-003 and the timing rules of docs/device-tree-design.md.

**Out of scope.** synchronous mode, smartcard, IrDA, LIN, RS-485 driver enable, auto baud rate, wake-up from stop mode, hardware flow control (stored only)
